name: Enumclaw Cascade Andesite Quarry
ceramic_role: Single-rock iron tenmoku glaze base (Fe2O3 + CaO + Na2O)
notes: Miocene Cascade andesite flow near Enumclaw; melts to dark glossy stoneware glaze around Cone 10.

name: Black Hills Tenino Crescent Basalt
ceramic_role: High-iron basaltic glaze & slip colorant (Fe2O3 + TiO2 + MgO)
notes: Eocene Crescent Formation oceanic basalt; rich in dark iron-titanium oxides for oil-spot and metallic glazes.

name: Greenwater Cascade Rhyolite-Dacite Ash
ceramic_role: High-silica alkali-fluxed volcanic ash glaze (SiO2 + K2O + Na2O)
notes: Pleistocene Cascade silicic tephra near Mt. Rainier; melts into pale celadon/ash glazes with minimal iron.

name: Hood River Columbia River Basalt Quarry
ceramic_role: Classic Columbia Gorge basalt glaze rock (Fe2O3 + CaO + MgO)
notes: Grande Ronde flood basalt; reliable studio rock-glaze standard at Cone 9-10 reduction or oxidation.

name: Skagit River Hamilton Talc & Soapstone
ceramic_role: Primary MgO satin-matte & thermal-shock flux (MgO + SiO2)
notes: Hydrothermally altered ultramafic belt near Hamilton; classic Washington source of magnesium silicate talc.

name: Marblemount Cascade Soapstone Belt
ceramic_role: Magnesium matte & Shino-crawl modifier (MgO)
notes: Steatite-chlorite schist exposed along the Skagit River corridor; low-iron MgO source when hand-sorted.

name: Twin Sisters Dunite & Olivine Massif
ceramic_role: High-MgO refractory silicate with trace chrome green tint (MgO + Cr2O3)
notes: Largest exposed alpine dunite body in the contiguous US; ~48% MgO with accessory chromite grains.

name: Sister Peaks Chromite Ultramafic Prospect
ceramic_role: Chrome-green / chrome-tin pink colorant & MgO flux (Cr2O3 + MgO)
notes: Podiform chromite lenses in Twin Sisters dunite; strong refractory green colorant—screen for Cr(VI) kiln flashing.

name: Chewelah Red Marble Magnesite
ceramic_role: High-purity MgO matte glaze & crawl-glaze carbonate (MgO)
notes: Historic Northwest Magnesite Belt in Stensgar Dolomite; calcines cleanly to reactive MgO.

name: Addy Dolomite & High-Mg Limestone
ceramic_role: Balanced CaO-MgO stoneware matte flux (CaO + MgO)
notes: Cambrian Metaline/Stensgar dolostone; standard studio dolomite substitute for silky Cone 6-10 mattes.

name: Chewelah Pegmatite & Potash Feldspar
ceramic_role: Primary alkali feldspar melter for bodies & glazes (K2O + Na2O + Al2O3)
notes: Coarse granitic pegmatite dikes intruding Loon Lake batholith; high-K microcline with clean quartz intergrowths.

name: Republic Ferry County Wollastonite Skarn
ceramic_role: Zero-LOI calcium silicate flux reducing pinholing (CaSiO3)
notes: Contact-metamorphosed siliceous marble near Republic; supplies CaO and SiO2 without carbonate CO2 outgassing.

name: Freeman Latah Kaolin & Fire Clay
ceramic_role: Refractory white kaolin & alumina-silica stiffener (Al2O3 + SiO2)
notes: Historic Freeman clay pits in weathered granite and Latah Formation; low-iron refractory stoneware/porcelain kaolin.

name: Mica Peak Residual Kaolin & Feldspar
ceramic_role: Kaolinitic white-firing wild stoneware clay & feldspar mix (Al2O3 + K2O)
notes: Deeply weathered granitic saprolite near Mica WA; historic Washington brick and refractory clay district.

name: Lane Mountain High-Purity Silica Quartzite
ceramic_role: Pure glass-former silica flint & thermal expansion control (SiO2)
notes: Addy Quartzite glass-sand deposit (>99% SiO2); wet ball-mill with strict crystalline silica dust PPE.

name: Olympic Peninsula Crescent Manganese
ceramic_role: Dark purple-brown metallic glaze colorant (MnO — neurotoxic dust/fume caution)
notes: Crescent Formation submarine manganese lenses near Lake Crescent; high MnO triggers ventilation & blistering checks.

name: Lake Cushman Olympic Manganese Prospect
ceramic_role: Manganese-iron metallic black/bronze glaze colorant (MnO + Fe2O3)
notes: Historic Hoodsport/Cushman manganese workings within 70 km of Tacoma; handle dry pyrolusite with P100 respirator.

name: Mount St. Helens 1980 Dacite Ash & Pumice
ceramic_role: Ready-ground volcanic ash stoneware glaze base (SiO2 + Al2O3 + Na2O + K2O)
notes: May 1980 dacitic tephra fallout; naturally fine-grained volcanic glass melting smoothly at Cone 6-10 with whiting.

name: Crater Lake Mazama Pumice & Volcanic Ash
ceramic_role: Rhyodacitic pumice glaze glass-former & alkali flux (SiO2 + Na2O + K2O)
notes: 7.7 ka Mount Mazama ash blanket; classic low-iron PNW volcanic ash glaze ingredient.

name: Black Hills Etta Spodumene Pegmatite
ceramic_role: Low-expansion lithium flux & shino/flameware modifier (Li2O + F caution from lepidolite)
notes: Famous giant-crystal LCT pegmatite near Keystone SD; spodumene supplies Li2O while lepidolite adds fluorine hazard.

name: Boise Basin Idaho LCT Pegmatite
ceramic_role: Lithium-alkali glaze flux & trace tin opacifier (Li2O + K2O + SnO2)
notes: Fractionated Idaho Batholith pegmatite swarm; elevated Rb/Cs pathfinder signal for unmeasured Li2O.

name: Alvord Basin Oregon Borax & Borates
ceramic_role: Mid-fire & low-fire boron glass-former flux (B2O3)
notes: Historic Harney County hot-spring playa borate flats; soluble borax plus low-solubility ulexite/colemanite.

name: Amargosa Nevada Colemanite & Borate
ceramic_role: Gerstley Borate / Gillespie Borate natural calcium-borate flux (B2O3 + CaO)
notes: Neogene lacustrine colemanite-ulexite beds; classic mid-range Cone 6 boron-calcium melter and glaze suspender.

name: Battle Mountain Nevada Barite & Fluorite
ceramic_role: Dry barium matte & blue-purple copper shift (BaO & F — non-food decorative only)
notes: Paleozoic bedded barite with fluorite veins; triggers barium toxicity and HF kiln-gas hazard screening.

name: Index Cascade Copper-Pyrite Sulfide Skarn
ceramic_role: Copper-iron celadon/oxblood & flashing colorant (CuO + pyrite — roast to 800C first)
notes: Historic Index mining district sulfide skarn; pyrite/chalcopyrite require oxidation roasting to avoid SO2 pinholing.
